note: ElevenLabs sound effects for the promo (owner's request, 14 Oct 2026). Files already in audio/sfx are kept; delete one to remake it.

sounds.text: A single soft, clean button tap on a phone touchscreen in a calm wellbeing app: a short warm click, subtle and modern, dry, no reverb, no beep
A soft, modern smartphone camera shutter: one quick, clean capture click, gentle and crisp, dry, no beeps or flash whine
A gentle, warm two-note confirmation chime when something is saved in a calm mobile app: soft rounded marimba tones, rising, short, quiet tail
A soft, friendly bubble pop as a cute cartoon helper pops onto a phone screen: light, round and playful, short, clean, no squeak
A soft, bright notification ping on a phone: one short clean bell note, friendly and light, dry, no reverb tail
A quick airy whoosh followed by a soft paper card landing on a desk: light, satisfying app transition, clean, no voice
Soft typing on a phone touchscreen keyboard: about twelve light, quick taps, close and clean, steady rhythm, no voice, no music
A gentle wooden tick as a timer starts in a calm app: one soft warm tick and a faint tock, dry, short
A light, airy swoosh as small items fly across a phone screen into a list: quick, playful and clean
A finger quickly flicking and scrolling a social media feed on a phone: three soft swipes on glass, close and clean
A soft, warm magical shimmer rising: gentle sparkle, bright and positive, short, no whoosh
Very soft twinkling chimes like stars appearing in a night sky: delicate, quiet and dreamy, sparse
A tiny crisp tick as an item is ticked off a checklist in a mobile app: short, clean and satisfying
A short, soft whoosh for a smooth camera move: airy and clean, quick rise and fall, no impact
A warm, satisfying brand logo hit: a soft deep thump with a bright bell shimmer on top that rings out, clean and positive
A soft, satisfying paper sticker being pressed onto a page: one quick light slap with a tiny papery peel, warm and dry, close up, no reverb, no music
One very quiet, soft detent click, like a smooth scroll wheel turning a single notch: tiny, crisp and dry, close up, no reverb, no beep
